# Code of conduct

Treat participants with respect in this repository's issues, pull requests, and reviews. Critique the work and explain disagreements with evidence.

Harassment, threats, discrimination, and sharing another person's private information are unacceptable. Maintainers may remove content or restrict participation to address these behaviors.

Use GitHub's **Report content** option to report abuse privately. The [GitHub Community Guidelines](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-community-guidelines) apply to participation in this project.
